sources.label: NAUR LesBin - Ultimate Relativity - G1 Adjust Role Quadrant, Buddy Swaps

steps.title: Stack in the middle
steps.rule: Wait together in the middle under Gaia; the debuffs land as the cast ends.

steps.title: 10s fires spread out
steps.cue: Gaia casts Speed: yellow and purple tethers on the hourglasses
steps.rule: North is relative: the plain hourglass between the two yellow-tethered ones, with the purple ones east and west. With a 10s Dark Fire, run out past your hourglass (support north, DPS south-west and south-east, R2 > R1 > M1 > M2 taking south-west); everyone else, Dark Blizzard included, stays stacked in the middle for Unholy Darkness.

steps.title: 30s fires bait, eruptions drop Return
steps.cue: The yellow-tethered hourglasses start Sinbound Meltdown
steps.rule: 30s fires (and a DPS with Dark Blizzard) bait the first lasers: stand right beside your hourglass, on the side it doesn't spin toward; supports take north-west and north-east (H2 > H1 > MT > OT on north-west), the DPS south. Dark Eruption players (10s fires, support ice, 20s support) drop their Return out toward their own spot, just inside the hourglass; Dark Water and the rest stay in the middle.

steps.title: Next wave: fires out, baiters in
steps.rule: Each wave repeats the pattern: the next fires walk out toward their spot, the next laser baiters go to their hourglass (10s fires and a support ice for the second wave, 20s fires for the third) and everyone else holds the middle. 30s fires drop their Return in the middle, where Shadoweye needs it.

steps.title: Back to the middle after your laser
20s fires spread out
steps.rule: With a 20s Dark Fire, go all the way out on your side: support west, DPS east. Everyone else stacks in the middle for Unholy Darkness, where the Dark Blizzard donut goes off too.

steps.title: 10s fires bait the second lasers
steps.cue: The plain hourglasses start Sinbound Meltdown
steps.rule: 10s fires and a support with Dark Blizzard go to their hourglass for the second lasers, stepping off to the side it doesn't spin toward; the 20s fires come back in and everyone else waits in the middle.

steps.title: 20s fires bait the last lasers
steps.cue: The purple-tethered hourglasses start Sinbound Meltdown
steps.rule: The 20s fires take the purple hourglasses' lasers (support west, DPS east); everyone else waits in the middle. Before the stun, everyone turns to face out toward their own hourglass so Shadoweye looks away from the group.

steps.title: Stack for Shell Crusher
steps.rule: After the rewind, everyone stacks in the middle for Shell Crusher.
